skill.summary: File format conversion skill. Convert between PDF, DOCX, Markdown, HTML, images, audio, and video formats.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of jpeng-file-converter.
- Supports conversion between popular document, image, audio, and video formats.
- Includes batch conversion, image resizing, and audio extraction from video.
- Simple command-line usage with customizable options for format, quality, and directories.
